note: Page County Conservation park on US-71 north of Clarinda, 164 acres of native timber; the campground is on the wooded drive in the east part of the park. A camping cabin can be reserved by phone. --Claude
summary: Changed fees low 6 -> 12: the $6 sites are the two primitive ones with no pad; the cheapest sites a 23-ft motorhome clearly fits are the $12 30/20 A pull-throughs (75-90 ft pads); high $15. Confirmed 50 A + water, 13 sites, pull-throughs, showers, dump, first-come. Added season Apr 15 - Nov 1. Pin ~720 m off at the US-71 entrance: corrected to the campground.
flags: PIN (~720 m off): stored 40.76368,-94.99008 is the park entrance on US-71. The campground is on the drive in the east of the park, where NAIP shows an RV, gravel spurs and a pull-through loop, and Google lists 'Nodaway Valley County Park Campground' at 40.75884,-94.98443. Proposed location 40.7589,-94.9844.

FEES: base set to $12 (sites 10-13, 30/20 A pull-throughs on 75-90 ft gravel pads). The $6 sites 1-2 are listed only as 'Primitive' with a fire ring and table and no pad, so they were not used as the base.
SITE COUNT: the county's own site lists 13 sites (1-13); its mycountyparks listing says 14 (2 primitive, 8 at 50 A, 4 at 30/20 A). Written 13 from the per-site page.
FIT: every electric site has a 42-90 ft gravel pad; a 23-ft motorhome fits.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (wooded upland campground; no water near the sites on NAIP).
